Overview

Sofia is a city in Sofia City with a population of 1,249,000. Bulgaria’s vibrant capital, set against the backdrop of Vitosha Mountain, with a mix of Roman ruins, Orthodox churches, Soviet architecture, and a thriving tech scene. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
